name: sgs/pay-later-message
title: Pay later message
description: Stripe's own buy-now-pay-later message (for example Klarna's instalments) for the live cart total, inside the Cart and Checkout blocks. Prints nothing while Stripe is absent or the method is not enabled.

message.label: Message
message._note: textColour and fontSize paint the placeholder through scoped rules (sgs_text_states_css) and also reach Stripe's message iframe as appearance variables (colorText, fontSizeBase), read by src/commerce-blocks/pay-later/messaging.js from the block's data-config.

method.description: The Stripe payment method whose message is shown. Nothing is printed unless that method is enabled in the Stripe plugin.

countryCode.description: Two-letter country for the message's terms. Empty uses the shopper's shipping country, then the shop's base country.

textColour.description: Message text colour (Stripe's colorText): a palette slug or any CSS colour; empty keeps Stripe's default.

logoColour.description: Colour of the provider's logo in the message (Stripe's logoColor).

fontSize.description: Message text size in px (Stripe's fontSizeBase); 0 keeps Stripe's default.
